sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 3246.7 ± 647.6 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Used in EDA and ALA binding assays; ligand binding to the N-terminally tagged full-length receptor was measured, confirming the construct is functional for ligand engagement.
sites.rationale: L5 explicitly states RLuc8 was fused to the N-terminus of full-length, membrane-anchored GPR120 (FFAR4). The topology landmarks confirm residues 1–40 are extracellular with no signal peptide (topology string begins with 'O'), so a prepend (insert_after_residue=0) places the tag on the extracellular surface. Python confirmed residue 1 = M and TM1 begins at residue 41, giving 40 residues of clearance—well above the ≥3-residue minimum. The paper names 'N-terminus' but no specific residue number; exactly one extracellular terminus exists, so the position is topology-derived. Full-length GPR120 (FFAR4) with Renilla luciferase (RLuc8) fused to the N-terminus (pcDNA3.1–RLuc8–GPR120) expressed in cells for EDA and ALA ligand binding assays. The topology shows no signal peptide (EC region begins at residue 1), so the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0) places the tag on the extracellular face, 40 residues from TM1.

sources.claim: For EDA and ALA binding assays, a Renilla luciferase (RLuc8) tag was fused to the N-terminus of GPR120 (pcDNA3.1–RLuc8–GPR120).

literature_notes: L1, L2, L3 (FFA4–Nluc, FFA4–YFP) and L6 (GPR120–YFP) all place tags at the C-terminus, which the topology landmarks assign to the intracellular region (residues 324–361); these are recorded in other_positions. L4 (mFFA4–HA knock-in) names no residue and no loop, and the clip does not specify whether the HA tag is at the N- or C-terminus; because both termini are plausible for an HA knock-in and the clip is ambiguous, the topology_derived rule (requiring exactly one extracellular terminus to be unambiguous) cannot be applied—L4 is therefore dropped as unpositionable. No ledger line supports an internal extracellular loop insertion for FFAR4.

literature_other_positions.note: FFA4–Nluc (NanoLuc at C-terminus) is functional by BRET and cAMP assays but the C-terminus (residues 324–361) is intracellular per topology landmarks; not a surface tag site.
FFA4–YFP (YFP at C-terminus) expressed in HEK293T cells and imaged by HILO microscopy; C-terminus is intracellular, not a surface tag site.
GPR120–YFP (YFP appended to C-terminus of full-length GPR120/FFAR4) used in β-arrestin recruitment BRET assays; C-terminus is intracellular per topology landmarks.
